title: Vegan Fried Rice
description: A classic Chinese-inspired vegan dish made with fried rice, vegetables, and spices.
instructions: Heat the vegan oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and bitter melon, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the wok, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice for 2-3 minutes, until it's heated through and starting to brown.
Add the aerated water to the wok, and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly separated.
Add the soy sauce and salt to the wok, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter, and garnish with fried shallots.
